high_level_description: The image features a person with short, dark hair styled in a sleek, side-swept manner. The feathers are predominantly white with some green and black accents, adding a vibrant and eye-catching element to the hairstyle. The bird ornament is detailed with what appears to be rhinestones or similar embellishments, giving it a sparkling appearance.
